catalog_name: Bangladesh BDIX Live TV Server Directory
source: User-provided BDIX FTP Server List — BDIX Connected Live TV Servers (copied as supplied; not independently checked)

live_tv.name: Live TV Servers
live_tv.description: Live TV, IPTV and television-platform endpoints listed by the supplied source. The category does not guarantee stream compatibility or current availability.

classification_notes: All numbered provider entries 1–50 are preserved as separate source records, including the two separately numbered BDIPTV entries.
ISP/provider names are transcribed from the source headings. Records labelled Unknown or Others are preserved as separate groups; no ISP attribution has been invented for their endpoints.
The source provides no separate provider websites or social links for these Live TV entries; endpoint URLs are stored under servers.live_tv.
All endpoints are unverified. Listing does not mean a server is online, reachable, BDIX-accessible, or capable of playing a stream.
URLs, schemes, ports, paths, and capitalization are preserved as supplied.
The final standalone http://iptv.mcnbd.com line repeats the endpoint listed under source entry 34. It is preserved in source_duplicate_occurrences rather than counted as a second canonical endpoint.
The category describes the source directory grouping, not a verified transport protocol or media format.

source_duplicate_occurrences.source_location: Standalone final line after the OTHERS LIVE TV SERVER list
source_duplicate_occurrences.handling: Preserved as a duplicate source occurrence; canonical endpoint remains under source entry 34.
